_comment: Stock agent-hook prompts that earlier versions of settings.json.template shipped, newest first, with the same placeholders. ensureAgentHooks replaces an agent's hook prompt that still equals one of these (after the same placeholder resolution) with the current template prompt; any other prompt was edited and stays. When a template prompt changes, add the old text here. An entry can also be what the X-Agent-Id header pass (upgradeTaskStateHeaderInHookPrompts) made of an older stock prompt: an agent it rewrote never edited its prompt.

## 1. Memória mentés
Nézd át az eddigi beszélgetést és mentsd el a fontos dolgokat.

- Fontos döntések, preferenciák, tanulságok (category=warm):
